text.p: These are the leading stories in the Malawi press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A financing company, Leasing and Financing Company, confiscated seven off-road vehicles from the main opposition Malawi Congress Party (MCP) after it failed to pay back three million Malawi kwacha.
- Malawi's flag carrier, Air Malawi, was on Wednesday reported missing in Dar-es-Salaam, Tanzania en route to Malawi from Dubai, United Arab Emirates, the airline said.
- Malawi will next year embark on a 34.5 billion Malawi kwacha ($2.3 million) mass housing programme to reduce housing shortage in the rural and urban areas.
